evidence_defaults.read_scope: Only the sections identified in locator were inspected; full-text access does not mean every supplement or figure image was reviewed.
evidence_defaults.tissue_cell_state: See model and genotype fields; no cells from this case were tested.
evidence_defaults.duration: Not extracted unless stated in exposure; do not infer an experimental duration.
evidence_defaults.replication_statistics: No independent replication established by this bounded search; numerical effect not extracted unless explicitly stated.
evidence_defaults.target_specificity: Not assessed in this evidence item unless explicitly stated.
evidence_defaults.orthogonal_validation: Not established by this item unless explicitly stated.
evidence_defaults.negative_conflicting: No exact-case result available; consult related evidence and candidate counterevidence.
evidence_defaults.case_relevance: Context transfer required; not evidence of clinical benefit in this case.

evidence_defaults.funding_conflicts: Not systematically extracted; no independence inferred from number of publications.

evidence.claim: A public ClinVar allele with p.Leu737Ter is NM_001211.6:c.2210T>G / NC_000015.10:g.40209701T>G; database pathogenic/likely pathogenic assertions do not verify this child's allele.
evidence.locator: HGVS; germline classification; submitter interpretations
evidence.genotype: Public c.2210T>G; patient identity and phase unverified
evidence.exposure: Not applicable: database assertion
evidence.effect_magnitude: Pathogenic/likely pathogenic aggregate; no formal classification assigned here
evidence.negative_conflicting: Underlying patient-specific RNA/protein rescue data not retrieved; do not substitute database assertion for experiment

evidence.claim: The retrieved p.Asn1002Lys ClinVar record is c.3006T>A, not a uniquely determined consequence-to-DNA mapping; it is a single-submitter VUS.
evidence.locator: HGVS; germline classification; submission details
evidence.exposure: Not applicable: database assertion
evidence.effect_magnitude: Uncertain significance; no variant-specific functional rescue experiment retrieved
evidence.negative_conflicting: Matching protein notation cannot establish that this nucleotide allele is present

evidence.claim: MANE Select BUB1B transcript is ENST00000287598.11 matched to NM_001211.6; its protein is NP_001202.5, 1050 aa. Reference-only context calculation places the public stop allele in exon 17 and missense allele in exon 23.
evidence.locator: MANE API; downloaded RefSeq GenBank and Ensembl exons; scripts/normalize_references.py; reference_context.json
evidence.genotype: Reference plus exact public E01/E02 alleles only
evidence.intervention_comparator: Reference allele substitution for sequence-context calculation
evidence.exposure: Not applicable: reference computation
evidence.effect_magnitude: Public c.2210T>G: TTA to TGA; context TCCCTACCAGAG[TGA]AGTGCCTCTGCA. Public c.3006T>A: AAT to AAA.

evidence.claim: UniProt annotates BUBR1 N-terminal domain 62-226 and protein-kinase domain 766-1050. A 1-736 product would lose the latter but retain N-terminal and KARD-region sequence; retention does not prove correct folding or binding.
evidence.locator: Features in downloaded uniprot_bubr1.json; domain and modification annotations
evidence.genotype: Reference; truncation consequences inferred for p.Leu737Ter
evidence.exposure: Not applicable: annotation
evidence.effect_magnitude: Retains Lys250 and the region including Lys668; loses annotated Thr792/Thr1008 and C-terminal sequence; Asn1002 lies in C-terminal kinase-like domain
evidence.negative_conflicting: Annotation name 'protein kinase' is not a rationale for generic kinase activation; catalytic and scaffold roles must be distinguished

evidence.claim: ClinGen gene-disease validity is definitive for autosomal-recessive BUB1B-related MVA1; this is not a variant classification or diagnosis.
evidence.locator: Folklore ClinGen snapshot 2026-03-16; classification date 2019-11-22
evidence.genotype: Biallelic disease model; this case unresolved
evidence.exposure: Not applicable
evidence.effect_magnitude: Definitive; autosomal recessive

evidence.claim: Original BUB1B MVA report identified truncating/missense variants in five families, including two with embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma.
evidence.locator: PubMed abstract; full text unavailable through DOI route
evidence.genotype: Reported biallelic BUB1B; not verified as either supplied allele
evidence.exposure: Not applicable
evidence.effect_magnitude: Five families; two with embryonal RMS, as reported in abstract

evidence.claim: Different MVA-associated BUBR1 mutations can reduce stability or impair checkpoint activity, making protein abundance an inadequate surrogate for function.
evidence.locator: Results and figures/captions, PDF pp3-10; mutant-expression and rescue experiments
evidence.model_species: Human MVA-derived cells and engineered human cell systems
evidence.genotype: Other published missense/truncating alleles; not Leu737Ter or Asn1002Lys
evidence.intervention_comparator: Mutant versus wild-type BUBR1 complementation; protein-stability manipulations
evidence.exposure: Construct-based expression; no clinically usable drug exposure established
evidence.endpoint: Protein stability, spindle checkpoint, chromosome alignment
evidence.effect_magnitude: Allele-dependent defects; no single transferable rescue magnitude
evidence.negative_conflicting: Some mutant effects are functional rather than simple instability

evidence.claim: BubR1 mouse allele combinations drive heterogeneous segregation, aging and tumor phenotypes; phenotype does not scale simply with total protein.
evidence.locator: Results/discussion PDF pp1-3,9-14; correction record inspected separately
evidence.genotype: Other engineered MVA-associated alleles and hypomorphic combinations
evidence.exposure: Genetic models; not pharmacology
evidence.endpoint: Mitotic fidelity, tissue decline and tumors
evidence.effect_magnitude: Context-dependent heterogeneity; no case-specific effect estimated
evidence.negative_conflicting: Not evidence that all BUB1B variants share hypomorph-aging physiology

evidence.claim: SIRT2-dependent deacetylation of BUBR1 Lys668 opposes CBP-associated acetylation, ubiquitination and degradation in studied systems.
evidence.locator: Results; Figs1-4; K668 mutagenesis, SIRT2 knockdown/overexpression and stability experiments
evidence.genotype: WT/engineered K668; Sirt2 perturbations; not supplied variants
evidence.intervention_comparator: SIRT2 gain/loss; K668 mutants; CBP perturbation
evidence.exposure: Genetic and biochemical perturbations; no approved selective SIRT2 activator established
evidence.effect_magnitude: Increased stability with SIRT2; not demonstrated rescue of either supplied allele
evidence.target_specificity: SIRT2 perturbation and residue mutants; cell-cycle composition examined
evidence.negative_conflicting: Stabilizing a defective protein can be neutral or harmful; normal and tumor effects untested here

evidence.claim: NMN increased NAD and BUBR1 abundance in studied mice/MEFs; SIRT2 transgene, not NMN treatment, supplied the reported BubR1-hypomorphic lifespan evidence.
evidence.locator: Figs5-6, results and discussion
evidence.model_species: Young/aged mice, testes and heart; WT and Sirt2-null MEFs; BubR1H/H mice for transgene study
evidence.genotype: Hypomorphic mouse allele and WT; not human variant pair
evidence.intervention_comparator: NMN versus PBS/vehicle; SIRT2 overexpression versus control
evidence.exposure: MEFs: 1 mM NMN, 24 h. Mouse experiment: 7 days; animal exposure is not a human dosing basis.
evidence.endpoint: NAD, BUBR1 abundance; distinct SIRT2-transgene survival endpoints
evidence.effect_magnitude: BUBR1 induction almost absent in Sirt2-null MEFs; abundance restored in aged testes; heart abundance not measurable in that comparison
evidence.replication_statistics: Fig6 n=3 per group, Student t tests; one research program, not independent replication
evidence.target_specificity: Sirt2-null control separates NAD increase from most BUBR1 induction
evidence.negative_conflicting: NMN is not treated as an approved medicine; NAD elevation is not selective SIRT2 activation

evidence.claim: SIRT2 also deacetylates mitotic BUBR1 Lys250 and participates in checkpoint silencing, so modification site and mitotic timing matter.
evidence.locator: PubMed abstract
evidence.exposure: Not extracted from abstract
evidence.effect_magnitude: Direction toward checkpoint silencing in studied mitotic context
evidence.negative_conflicting: Does not refute K668 stability data; prevents assuming all SIRT2 effects strengthen checkpoint

evidence.claim: Engineered BUBR1(1-730) restored chromosome alignment whereas B56-binding-defective mutants did not; kinetochore-targeted B56 rescued alignment in MVA-derived cells.
evidence.locator: Results; Figs1-4; cell culture and imaging methods
evidence.model_species: Human HeLa and published MVA-derived cell lines
evidence.genotype: Other MVA cell lines; engineered 1-730 and B56-binding mutants; not Leu737Ter
evidence.intervention_comparator: WT/truncated/mutant complementation and kinetochore-targeted B56 versus controls
evidence.exposure: Genetic constructs; MG132 metaphase-arrest context; no approved targeted-recruitment drug
evidence.effect_magnitude: 1-730 restored alignment in 80% of measured HeLa cells in cited assay; not a case-specific rescue fraction
evidence.target_specificity: B56-binding mutants and targeted localization distinguish recruitment from bulk phosphatase activity
evidence.orthogonal_validation: Binding, localization, alignment and fiber assays
evidence.negative_conflicting: Alignment under metaphase arrest is not unbiased completed-division fidelity; MVA line provenance may overlap earlier cohorts

evidence.claim: Aurora B inhibition partially rescued attachment/congression defects in BUBR1/B56-deficient systems; PLK1 inhibition did not in this study.
evidence.locator: Fig3 and discussion; ZM447439 versus BI2536
evidence.model_species: Human HeLa and B56/BUBR1 perturbation contexts
evidence.exposure: ZM447439 2 micromolar for 1 h in MG132-containing medium for stated congression assay
evidence.effect_magnitude: Partial rescue by Aurora B inhibition; PLK1 inhibitor failed and caused spindle abnormalities
evidence.negative_conflicting: Authors note difference from earlier PLK1-related report; over-inhibition can disable attachment-error correction

evidence.claim: BUBR1 binding to PP2A-B56 supports stable attachments; artificial kinetochore targeting can bypass the recruitment deficit.
evidence.locator: PubMed abstract retrieved during PP2A search
evidence.exposure: Genetic/research-tool context
evidence.effect_magnitude: Convergent support for recruitment mechanism; not an independent test of this variant pair

evidence.claim: Genetically enabled removal of p16Ink4a-positive cells delayed selected tissue phenotypes in BubR1 hypomorphic mice, without demonstrating chromosome-segregation correction.
evidence.locator: INK-ATTAC mechanism, intervention groups, tissue results and limitations
evidence.model_species: Mouse adipose, skeletal muscle and eye
evidence.intervention_comparator: AP20187-induced transgenic cell clearance versus controls
evidence.exposure: Dimerizer requires engineered suicide transgene; not an approved senolytic treatment
evidence.endpoint: Senescent cell burden; selected age-associated tissue phenotypes
evidence.effect_magnitude: Delay/attenuation in selected tissues; no universal phenotype or lifespan rescue inferred
evidence.negative_conflicting: Genetic cell clearance is not dasatinib efficacy; removing cells is not correcting their initiating defect

evidence.claim: p21/p53 effects in BubR1 hypomorphic tissues are context-dependent; the paper reports preliminary unpublished rapamycin experiments with similar phenotype rates to control.
evidence.locator: Discussion paragraph beginning 'In preliminary studies'; p21/p53 tissue comparisons
evidence.intervention_comparator: Rapamycin diet versus control, described but not presented as full experiment
evidence.exposure: Exposure details not available in the unpublished statement
evidence.effect_magnitude: Reported similar rates; no numerical estimate or uncertainty supplied
evidence.negative_conflicting: Low-rigor negative signal against a generic rapamycin rescue; not a definitive efficacy trial

evidence.claim: Dasatinib/quercetin senolytic work used context-dependent senescent-cell models; it does not replicate transgenic senescent-cell clearance in this BUB1B genotype.
evidence.locator: Abstract; full text not obtained through DOI route
evidence.model_species: Human senescent cells and mouse aging/injury models
evidence.exposure: Not extracted; combination does not establish dasatinib monotherapy efficacy
evidence.endpoint: Senescent cell viability and tissue endpoints
evidence.effect_magnitude: Cell-type-dependent senolytic effects; no BUB1B-specific therapeutic window demonstrated
evidence.negative_conflicting: Quercetin is not included as an approved medicine; loss of protective senescence and marrow toxicity matter

evidence.claim: Gentamicin readthrough efficiency varies with stop codon and flanking sequence in mammalian reporters; longer protein is not proof of useful BUBR1.
evidence.locator: Fig1; results; methods; original HTML used to resolve corrupted micro symbol in PDF extraction
evidence.exposure: 800 micrograms/mL, 24 h; original HTML explicitly reports micrograms, not milligrams
evidence.effect_magnitude: Strong context dependence; not a clinical exposure target and not BUB1B rescue
evidence.replication_statistics: At least three independent experiments per sequence; study-specific analyses, not independent lab replication
evidence.negative_conflicting: Clinical antibacterial exposure cannot be assumed to reproduce this reporter exposure; incorporated residue unmeasured for BUB1B

evidence.claim: RAS/MAPK activation creates an increased dependence on BUBR1-mediated phosphatase balance; research MEK inhibition rescued chromosome alignment after BUBR1 depletion in transformed cells.
evidence.locator: Figs1,3,5; results on U0126, Hec1 phosphorylation, kinetochore kinases; engineered ARPE19 background
evidence.model_species: Human engineered retinal epithelial cells and glioblastoma isolates
evidence.genotype: TERT/mTP53DD/CCND1/CDK4R24C background with active RAS/MEK; BUBR1 depletion; not MVA alleles
evidence.intervention_comparator: U0126/ERK research inhibitor versus vehicle; oncogenic backgrounds
evidence.exposure: Brief treatment; 1 h for cited phosphorylation/interkinetochore assays; concentration not extracted
evidence.endpoint: Chromosome alignment, Hec1 phosphorylation, segregation in separate assays
evidence.effect_magnitude: Alignment rescued to >90% in selected BUBR1-depleted RAS/MEK-transformed cells; not trametinib or RMS patient rescue
evidence.target_specificity: Oncogenic-background controls; MEK and ERK perturbations
evidence.orthogonal_validation: Phosphorylation, alignment, mitotic timing and segregation assays
evidence.negative_conflicting: Restoring mitotic fitness may protect a tumor from mitotic stress; no transfer to normal MVA cells without hyperactive MAPK

evidence.claim: BUBR1 overexpression and specific CDC20-binding-domain manipulations can protect against aneuploidy and cancer in mouse models; N-terminal CDC20 binding is necessary but not sufficient.
evidence.locator: Results and discussion on BubR1N/BubR1I transgenes
evidence.genotype: Engineered overexpression/motif mutants, not supplied variants
evidence.intervention_comparator: Full-length and domain-mutant transgenes versus controls
evidence.exposure: Genetic overexpression; not a drug
evidence.effect_magnitude: Domain-specific protection; no inference that any increase of any allele is beneficial
evidence.negative_conflicting: Constitutive transgenes and cancer prevention differ from stabilizing mutant BUBR1 in an existing tumor

evidence.claim: ARST0921 favored a temsirolimus-containing relapse regimen over a bevacizumab-containing regimen; it was not temsirolimus versus chemotherapy alone.
evidence.locator: Methods, primary EFS analysis, discussion and regimen-selection design
evidence.intervention_comparator: Vinorelbine/cyclophosphamide with temsirolimus versus with bevacizumab
evidence.exposure: Published combination trial; no patient dose reproduced here
evidence.effect_magnitude: EFS favored temsirolimus-containing arm; not a monotherapy effect
evidence.replication_statistics: Randomized selection trial; early selection and comparator limit causal attribution to adding temsirolimus
evidence.negative_conflicting: Later different-population phase3 result negative, E22

evidence.claim: ARST1431 did not show improved EFS from adding temsirolimus to VAC/VI in newly diagnosed intermediate-risk RMS.
evidence.locator: Findings; revised intention-to-treat methods; results and toxicity discussion
evidence.exposure: Published combination trial; no dose proposal
evidence.effect_magnitude: 297 evaluable; 66.8% versus 64.8%; HR 0.86, 95% CI 0.58-1.26; log-rank p=0.44; one treatment-related death in temsirolimus arm
evidence.replication_statistics: Primary reported survival analysis; no new meta-analysis or p-value adjustment conducted here
evidence.negative_conflicting: Does not prove no effect in every molecular subgroup or in relapse; defeats general positive RMS extrapolation

evidence.claim: High-dose metformin induced low-glucose-dependent genotoxic stress in a study linking oxidative injury, spindle abnormalities and BUBR1 changes.
evidence.locator: PubMed abstract
evidence.exposure: Exact concentration not available in accessed abstract; do not extrapolate to standard human use
evidence.effect_magnitude: Context-dependent injury rather than generic protection
evidence.negative_conflicting: Does not establish metformin causes this effect at usual clinical exposure; does counter unqualified genome-protection claims

evidence.claim: Increased BUB1B in a non-MVA cancer model contributed to aberrant DNA-repair-associated treatment resistance; normal-cell BUBR1 support need not be tumor-neutral.
evidence.locator: Opening results and abstract of retrieved full text
evidence.exposure: Not used for quantitative exposure comparison
evidence.effect_magnitude: Tumor-promoting/resistance direction in that context; not proof in RMS
evidence.negative_conflicting: CIN is not homologous-recombination deficiency; no PARP-inhibitor indication follows

evidence.claim: HP:0002859 is Rhabdomyosarcoma; HP:0000121 Nephrocalcinosis; HP:0004322 Short stature; HP:0001508 Failure to thrive; HP:0003202 Skeletal muscle atrophy; HP:0001622 Premature birth; HP:0001518 Small for gestational age; HP:0200067 Recurrent spontaneous abortion.
evidence.locator: Exact id/name/definition blocks; phenotype_terms.csv
evidence.exposure: Not applicable
evidence.effect_magnitude: Parental miscarriage term belongs in family history; low muscle bulk does not independently establish atrophy; SGA requires gestational-age reference

evidence.claim: GSE67905 profiles HeLa cells after BUBR1 and CENP-E/Eg5 siRNA perturbation; it is not a patient rescue drug dataset.

evidence.exposure: Three days; siRNA concentration not provided in series record
evidence.effect_magnitude: Eight listed samples; duplicate treatments; raw data not reanalyzed

evidence.exposure: No BUB1B-specific exposure extracted

evidence.claim: EMA records that Translarna's EU conditional marketing authorization was not renewed; it must not be listed as currently EU-approved.

evidence.exposure: No BUB1B exposure established
evidence.effect_magnitude: EU non-renewal; historical approval is not current availability

regulatory: Injection IM/IV; US ANDA; serious susceptible bacterial infections, including pediatric/neonatal infections
Renal injury, irreversible auditory/vestibular toxicity, neuromuscular blockade; avoid additive nephrotoxic/ototoxic drugs and loop diuretics. Approval does not establish readthrough exposure.
Rapamune oral solution/tablets; US approved renal-transplant rejection prophylaxis age >=13 and LAM; pediatric LAM efficacy not established
Infection/malignancy boxed warning, cytopenias, proteinuria, wound healing, pneumonitis, metabolic effects; CYP3A4/P-gp interactions. No congenital MVA benefit established.
Torisel IV; US approved advanced renal-cell carcinoma; pediatric effectiveness not established; not RMS approval
Cytopenias, mucositis, infection, renal failure/proteinuria, pneumonitis, impaired wound healing; CYP3A4 interactions.
Sprycel tablets; US adult Ph+ leukemias and specified pediatric Ph+ CML/ALL indications age >=1; no senolysis indication
Marrow suppression, bleeding, pleural fluid, PAH, growth/bone development effects, CYP3A4 interactions and acid-suppressant interactions; no MVA senolytic window.
Immediate-release oral tablets; US approved type2 diabetes age >=10; do not generalize to every formulation
Lactic acidosis risk with renal impairment, hypoxia and mitochondrial disease; GI burden/B12 depletion; clearance, carbonic-anhydrase-inhibitor and contrast interactions.
Urocit-K extended-release tablets; US RTA with calcium stones, hypocitraturic calcium-oxalate nephrolithiasis, uric-acid lithiasis; pediatric safety/effectiveness not established
Potassium retention/hyperkalemia, renal-function contraindication, GI lesions and formulation limits; interactions with potassium-sparing agents, RAAS blockers and NSAIDs.
Gilenya capsules; US relapsing MS age >=10; established approved action is S1P-receptor modulation
Bradyarrhythmia, infection/lymphocyte effects, macular edema, liver injury, malignancy and additive immunosuppression with antineoplastics; no selective kinetochore PP2A-B56 recruitment demonstrated.
Velcade SC/IV injection; US adult multiple myeloma/mantle-cell lymphoma; pediatric safety/effectiveness not established
Neuropathy, cytopenias, cardiac/pulmonary toxicity, tumor lysis and thrombotic microangiopathy; CYP3A4 interactions; broad proteasome block is not BUBR1-specific stabilization.
Norditropin SC; US specified pediatric growth disorders and adult GH deficiency; SGA indication has catch-up/age criteria
Active malignancy contraindication; second neoplasms in specified childhood cancer survivors, glucose intolerance, intracranial hypertension and skeletal growth complications.
Mekinist tablets/oral solution; US selected BRAF-mutant indications; pediatric age >=1 combination with dabrafenib for specified BRAF V600E tumors/LGG; pediatric monotherapy not established

Cardiomyopathy, ocular toxicity, hemorrhage, skin/GI/lung toxicity; combination-specific fever/new-malignancy risks must not be misattributed to single agent. No MVA or generic RAS-mutant RMS approval.

additional_evidence.endpoint: Regulatory eligibility, tumor responses and safety
additional_evidence.effect_magnitude: Approval requires metastatic or severe-morbidity surgical context and no satisfactory alternative/progression; CNS, hepatic, skeletal-fracture and hematologic risks
